status: Structure extracted from Skill 78's own references (selection-copy-profile.md page shape, selection-ui-contract.md). Skill 78 states that no pre-existing exact selection-page copy framework was supplied; this is the new design contract, not BlackCEO source copy. No character or word band is invented: the copy is checked for its sections, its order, one button per package card and no button elsewhere.

counting_convention.char_counting: Join the visible components with one space; count letters, punctuation, and spaces.
counting_convention.word_tokenization: Strip markers, normalize whitespace, count whitespace-separated tokens.

sections.job: Acknowledges the interest the visitor just showed; it picks up from the landing page and never re-sells the whole offer.
sections.behavior_notes: Brand band; no button on this section

sections.job: One plain paragraph on what choosing means and how the packages differ.
sections.behavior_notes: One plain paragraph; no button on this section

sections.job: One card per approved package, in approved order: exact name, who it suits, main outcome, specific inclusions, visible exclusions, exact price and terms, and a Choose button.

element_counts.source: 78-signature-product-selection/references/selection-copy-profile.md (Page shape), item 3 (inclusions stated specifically, exclusions visible)

sections.behavior_notes: Radio group of cards, none pre-selected; one Choose button per card

sections.job: The comparison grid: for each item, whether each package includes it, does not include it, limits it or makes it conditional. Exclusions stay visible on desktop and mobile.
sections.behavior_notes: Desktop table, mobile disclosure; exclusions stay visible

sections.job: Common questions and trust information, supported by real evidence only; no invented proof.
sections.behavior_notes: Questions then trust lines; no button on this section

cta_map.module_anatomy: One button per package card, labelled Choose plus the exact package name; no payment language and no sticky or floating button.
cta_map.position_semantics: Buttons sit inside their package cards, in card order; Section 3 carries all of them.

1.purpose: Bridge from the interest the visitor just showed to the choice below
1.slots: no image slot by default; a brand-colour band carries the headline

2.purpose: Explain in one plain paragraph how the packages differ

3.purpose: One selectable card per package, side by side on desktop and stacked on mobile
3.slots: one labelled image plate per package card (client-supplied or generated), in card order

4.purpose: Comparison grid of what each package includes, excludes, limits or conditions
4.slots: no image slot; a table on desktop and a disclosure on mobile

5.purpose: Common questions and trust information backed by real evidence

wireframe.height_floor_note: Derived, not measured: the standard desktop wireframe sheet is 16,736px for 12 sections (1,394.7px each); 5 sections x 1,394.7 = about 6,973px. No product-selection sheet exists to measure; replace with a measured value once Trevor approves one.

anti_requirements: No invented prices, savings, popularity or scarcity claims; every figure is the approved catalog's.
